work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. V heading 7924/synopsis 7927–7941 precede self-protocol 7943–7944. Exposition introduces an incorporated congregational decree at 7989–7991 (tenoris sequentis), by the cardinals for bishops and regulars; its quoted body/dating/signatures occupy 7991–8006. Papal narrative resumes §2 at 8008–8013 and expressly confirms the praeinsertum decree at 8032–8036, proving membership rather than a neighboring standalone curial act. Own historical notes 7971 and 8020 attach to marked text. Ordered §§1–5 reach complete papal dating 8052–8055, then VI heading 8058. No body reversal found.
